principle: Expose human intent, not internal authority topology.

user_actions.label: Sign In
user_actions.meaning: Select and authenticate an existing Entity/principal relationship.

user_actions.label: Authorize
user_actions.meaning: Grant an explicit scoped capability; default is deny.

user_actions.label: Created by me — verified
user_actions.must_not_mean: Legal ownership or factual truth automatically proven

user_actions.label: Export My Entity
user_actions.meaning: Create a signed portable Entity export.

user_actions.label: Move My Entity
user_actions.meaning: Export, import into another provider, verify unchanged identity/controller continuity, reconnect services.

user_actions.label: Recover
user_actions.meaning: Use governed recovery authority without assigning sovereignty to the recovery provider.
